description: Defines interfaces and classes for message output and publishing, including console, syslog, file, JSON formatting, UDP, and WebSocket outputs within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: IPublish
classes.description: Interface for publishing messages with a Message method.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class for converting message info and text, non-copyable.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs to console.

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs to syslog.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs to a file.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Class for JSON formatted message output with configurable options.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs via UDP socket.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that manages WebSocket connections and JSON message dispatch.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method in IPublish interface for sending messages.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Method in Text class to convert message info and text.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method in ConsoleOutput, SyslogOutput, FileOutput to output messages.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Getter and setter for filename output option in JSON class.

methods.name: LineNumber
methods.description: Getter and setter for line number output option in JSON class.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Getter and setter for class name output option in JSON class.

methods.name: Module
methods.description: Getter and setter for module output option in JSON class.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Getter and setter for category output option in JSON class.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Getter and setter for callsign output option in JSON class.

methods.name: Date
methods.description: Getter and setter for date inclusion in JSON class.

methods.name: Paused
methods.description: Getter and setter for paused state in JSON class.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Method to convert message info and text into JSON data.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Method in UDPOutput's Channel class to send data.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Method in UDPOutput's Channel class to handle state changes.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method in UDPOutput and WebSocketOutput to send messages.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to initialize server with service and max connections.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to clean up resources.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Method to attach a new WebSocket client connection.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Method to detach a WebSocket client connection.

methods.name: MaxConnections
methods.description: Getter for maximum WebSocket connections.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Method to process incoming JSON commands for WebSocket clients.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: Method to get a new JSON command object.
